correctness.rationale: For g_c(v)=h(|v|)-h(x)-c h(z), the all-ensemble inequality equals Jensen concavity of g_c. The negative radial Hessian is R=A I+(B-A)u u^T with inverse R^-1=A^-1 I-(1-delta)vv^T. The Schur complement for x/z curvature gives Q_c with determinant delta*a*(Y+Z)*(1-Z)+delta² Y s-(1-2delta) XZ, a=1/c-1, delta=(1-A^-1)/s>=1/3. The largest required a at each radius is s(1-2delta)/delta, approached by Y=0,Z→0+,X=s-Z, yielding the exact global a*. This proves concavity for c=c*, violation for any larger c by local two-point ensembles, and pure-state extension by continuity; two oriented applications plus dephasing data processing yield the cross-information corollary. Independently verified determinant symbolically, a*=0.2647413168287692, c*=0.7906755213053483 numerically and a concrete Schur-negative witness for c>c*; decimal is diagnostic only.
